description: Curated subset of research benchmark tasks for the Falsifiable Prediction Graph Planner vs Standard Procedural Planner comparison demo. Each task is either a true-positive empirical task or a negative control failure condition.

tasks.description: Empirical regression task: predict housing prices from demographic features using linear models with regularization.
Empirical classification task: medical diagnosis from patient biomarkers using gradient-boosted trees.
Empirical NLP task: sentiment analysis on product reviews using fine-tuned transformer classifiers.
Empirical time series task: electricity demand forecasting using ARIMA and neural sequence models.
Empirical causal discovery task: infer gene regulatory network structure from perturbation data.
Negative control regression task: predict random noise from housing features - no true signal exists.
Negative control classification task: classify random labels from patient biomarkers - no true signal exists.
Negative control NLP task: predict shuffled sentiment labels from product reviews - no true signal exists.
Negative control time series task: forecast permuted electricity demand - no true signal exists.
Negative control causal discovery task: infer structure from randomized perturbation data - no true signal exists.
